name: Arrive AI Inc.
summary: Arrive AI Inc. operates a subscription-based "Mailbox-as-a-Service" platform. This innovative system facilitates the automated, on-demand, and secure delivery of various goods, including packages, products, and food. It boasts intelligent, climate-controlled features and can receive items from a diverse range of delivery methods, such as traditional couriers, drones, and robotic systems. Established in 2020, the company is based in Fishers, Indiana. It was previously recognized as Arrive Technology Inc. before officially changing its name to Arrive AI Inc. in September 2024.
